column1: # C: structs and typedef names (class), functions including those returning a pointer or
# written behind an attribute macro (function). A struct that is only named
# (`struct pending;`, `typedef struct wire wire_t;`) is not a definition; a function-pointer
# typedef is recorded under its own name, never its return type. A function-like #define is a
# function named by the macro (object-like ones are not recorded). A function written as a macro
# call and a block is recorded under what the macro defines: NAME(f, ...) is f, SYSCALL_DEFINEn(f, ...)
# is sys_f, COMPAT_SYSCALL_DEFINEn(f, ...) is compat_sys_f, TEST_F(suite, case) is suite_case. File-level variables,
# enums and unions are not listed; see KNOWN_GAPS.md.
